subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do the security and CI owners approve advancing these exact SHA-pinned action revisions in workflows that receive app private keys, registry credentials, GitHub tokens, or OpenAI API keys?
rationale: The branch is mechanically narrow, but deciding whether the newly executed third-party action code is trusted with those credentials is an owner security decision that CI cannot establish.

options.title: Approve after revision audit
options.body: Review the upstream release diffs and exact commit pins for the credential-bearing actions, then approve this current head if the changes are acceptable.

options.title: Split sensitive pins
options.body: Land only action updates without privileged credential access and defer token, publishing, and Codex-action revisions for separate owner review.
